data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to exclude Android system gesture navigation in specific UI areas.
data.what_it_does: Wraps Android's View#getSystemGestureExclusionRects() API to prevent conflicts between system gesture navigation and app gestures. Provides a widget and an instance API to define exclusion rectangles on Android devices.
use_when: You need to prevent Android system gestures from interfering with edge‑swipe UI components
Your app runs on Android 10+ and uses custom gestures near screen edges
avoid_when: Building for iOS or other non‑Android platforms
You don't use edge gestures that conflict with system navigation
strengths: Works with both widget and instance APIs
weaknesses: Manual rect calculation needed for instance API
